name: Omoide no Kaeru Basho
source:
Main character visits home town to meet old friends and pay respect to recently died teacher. He also hopes to meet mysterious girl that made a striking impression on him 10 years ago and disappeared. He finds that girl's diary, and its records make his heart tremble.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-april-2003-zanmataisei.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公回到故乡，一方面与老朋友重逢，一方面悼念不久前去世的老师。他也希望能再见到十年前那名给自己留下强烈印象、随后销声匿迹的神秘少女。后来，他找到了少女的日记，其中的记录令他心潮难平。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-april-2003-zanmataisei.html]vndbreview[/url]]
